name: Soochak by BizBandhan
summary: Developer-first Web Push notification management platform for organizations.

technology.deployment: Docker Compose with an NGINX gateway

capabilities.name: Organization signup and hostname-scoped dashboard sessions
Web Push configuration and subscriber management
Downloadable browser integration client and Service Worker handler
Notification dispatch and provider outcome reporting

not_yet_implemented_as_complete_features: Durable notification queue, separate delivery workers, and complete scheduling/retry behavior
workspace_model: During the prototype, each user has one unique Soochak dashboard/API hostname that scopes the workspace; the customer's website origin is separate configuration. There is no separate tenant ID.
important_limitations: Provider acceptance does not confirm device delivery, display, or reading.
A website's existing Service Worker must not be silently replaced.
HTTPS and an explicit user action are required for browser permission and subscription flows.
Prototype status does not imply production readiness, an SLA, or guaranteed delivery.
